item.tib: khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum phyag bzhes gsal byed nyi ma'i dbang po
item.coloph: khro bo lha rgod thog pa'i bsnyen sgrab las gsum gyi phyag bzhes gsal byed nyi ma'i dbang po 'di yang / rje rin po che rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam 'dren dam pa/ bsod nams blo gros dbang gi rgyal po'i gsang mtshan shes rab dgongs rgyal de nyid kyis mdzad pa tha dag gi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa'i/ gter rgyud dang snyan rgyud gnyis su zung 'brel gyi snyigs dus 'gro ba'i don du shin tu mngags pa zhig yin pa'i (pas/)'di yi bstan pa'i gsal byed thams cad khyod kyis dgos gsungs nas/ bka'i gnang ba ldog med du rtsol bzhin du/ rje rin po che de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bor cod paN du bcings pa'i kho bo thos chung ba mdo gam ma ha b+ho ti dbang bsgyar gyi gnam bskos mi dbang sde dge'i rgyal po'i mnga' ris su skyes pa'i phran skam rigs kyi ser gzugs pa/ brda sprod phywa yi ming du/ blo gros lo tog legs pa'am/ 'bod pa nang gi ming la/ drung mu nyi wer du 'bod pa bdag gis/ rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta yi lo dka' thub zla ba'i yar tshes la/ rje rin po che mnyam med chen po'i dus chen gyi/ rdzogs pa gsum pa'i nyin par gangs can bod kyi 'du gnas chen po/ bkra shis sman ri'i bla brang chen po'i g.yas zur gyi ming dang don gnyis mtshungs par skye dgu'i kun gyi spyi phud bkur ti'i (bsti'i) rtsa ba ru gyur pa'i rten 'brel thob pa'i khams tshan gyi grwa gshag dang po ru sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa rin po che dar ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
